title: fanoutqa: Which of the main actors from the movie “The Avengers” have won Academy Awards? (29242cc91b49e88e)

chat_history.content: Which of the main actors from the movie “The Avengers” have won Academy Awards?

content.content:
The user asks: "Which of the main actors from the movie 'The Avengers' have won Academy Awards?" Need to list main actors and indicate which have won Oscars.

Main actors in The Avengers (2012): Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Hemsworth, Scarlett Johansson, Jeremy Renner, Tom Hiddleston (though not main? he's Loki), Clark Gregg, etc. Also maybe Samuel L. Jackson cameo, but main cast.

Now need to identify which of these have won Academy Awards.

As of now (2025), Oscar winners among them: Scarlett Johansson has not won an Oscar (nominated). Robert Downey Jr. hasn't won (nominated? He hasn't been nominated). Chris Evans hasn't. Mark Ruffalo hasn't. Chris Hemsworth hasn't. Jeremy Renner hasn't. Tom Hiddleston hasn't. Samuel L. Jackson hasn't (though many nominations). However, there is one: Jeremy Renner? He hasn't. So none of the main Avengers cast have won Oscars. Wait, but maybe "The Avengers" also includes "Gwyneth Paltrow"? Not main. But she hasn't either. "Samuel L. Jackson" hasn't won.

But there is an Oscar winner among the supporting cast: "Anthony Hopkins"? Not in Avengers. "Jude Law"? Not. So answer: none have won Oscars. However, there is "Robert Downey Jr." got an Oscar? No.

Thus answer: None of the principal Avengers cast have won Academy Awards; they have received nominations? Actually, only "Scarlett Johansson" got a nomination for Best Actress for Lost in Translation (not Oscar) Actually she got a BAFTA nomination. No Oscar nomination.

Thus answer: None. Provide brief list of main actors and note that none have won.

Be concise.

content:
**Main‑cast members of *The Avengers* (2012)**  

| Actor | Notable role in the film | Academy Award (Oscar) win? |
|-------|--------------------------|-----------------------------|
| Robert Downey Jr. | Tony Stark / Iron Man | **No** |
| Chris Evans | Steve Rogers / Captain America | **No** |
| Mark Ruffalo | Bruce Banner / Hulk | **No** |
| Chris Hemsworth | Thor | **No** |
| Scarlett Johansson | Natasha Romanoff / Black Widow | **No** |
| Jeremy Renner | Clint Barton / Hawkeye | **No** |
| Tom Hiddleston* | Loki (antagonist) | **No** |
| Samuel L. Jackson* | Nick Fury (cameo) | **No** |
| Clark Gregg* | Agent Coulson (support) | **No** |

\*Listed for completeness; they are not part of the core “Avengers” team but appear prominently in the movie.

**Result:** None of the principal actors who appear in *The Avengers* have won an Academy Award (Oscar) to date. (Some have received nominations for other awards, but no Oscar wins.)
